summary: An agile method for AI-driven development that guides your coding agent from idea to briefs, specs, architecture and working code.

heroCommands.comment: Install the stable release in your project

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: BMad Method is an agile framework for building software with AI coding agents. It turns an idea or change request into briefs, specifications, architecture and working code, keeping the key decisions with you instead of handing everything to the model.
sixtySeconds.problem: Coding agents jump straight to code and lose track of what you are building and why. BMad adds a structured, agile process that covers planning, design and change, so the project holds together as it grows.
whoFor: Developers building projects with AI coding tools
Small teams that want a repeatable AI workflow
Product people writing briefs and specs with AI
Teams adding AI planning to an existing delivery process
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it when you want a full method rather than ad-hoc prompts: you can run it end to end or take its briefs, specs and architecture into your own workflow.

overview: BMad ships on two lines. The stable v6.12 release installs with the npm installer and only receives bug fixes. V7 is a preview alpha installed as agent skills, and the README warns it can change between updates.
After installing v6.12, open your project in your AI coding tool, invoke bmad-build with what you want to change, and run bmad-help whenever you want guidance on the next step.
